bibliography.title: SANA-Video: Efficient Video Generation with Block Linear Diffusion Transformer

sections.title: 3.3.1 Block Linear Attention with KV Cache

abstract_sentences.text: We introduce SANA-Video, a small diffusion model that can efficiently generate videos up to 720×1280 resolution and minute-length duration.

evidence.anchor: up to 720×1280 resolution and minute-length duration

abstract_sentences.text: SANA-Video synthesizes high-resolution, high-quality and long videos with strong text-video alignment at a remarkably fast speed, deployable on RTX 5090 GPU.

evidence.anchor: strong text-video alignment at a remarkably fast speed

abstract_sentences.text: Two core designs ensure our efficient, effective and long video generation: (1) Linear DiT: We leverage linear attention as the core operation, which is more efficient than vanilla attention given the large number of tokens processed in video generation.

evidence.anchor: Two core designs ensure our efficient, effective and long video generation

abstract_sentences.text: (2) Constant-Memory KV cache for Block Linear Attention: we design block-wise autoregressive approach for long video generation by employing a constant-memory state, derived from the cumulative properties of linear attention.

evidence.anchor: constant-memory state, derived from the cumulative properties of linear attention

abstract_sentences.text: This KV cache provides the Linear DiT with global context at a fixed memory cost, eliminating the need for a traditional KV cache and enabling efficient, minute-long video generation.

evidence.anchor: global context at a fixed memory cost

abstract_sentences.text: In addition, we explore effective data filters and model training strategies, narrowing the training cost to 12 days on 64 H100 GPUs, which is only 1% of the cost of MovieGen.

evidence.anchor: 12 days on 64 H100 GPUs, which is only 1% of the cost of MovieGen

abstract_sentences.text: Given its low cost, SANA-Video achieves competitive performance compared to modern state-of-the-art small diffusion models (e.g., Wan 2.1-1.3B and SkyReel-V2-1.3B) while being 16× faster in measured latency.

evidence.anchor: 16× faster in measured latency

abstract_sentences.text: Moreover, SANA-Video can be deployed on RTX 5090 GPUs with NVFP4 precision, accelerating the inference speed of generating a 5-second 720p video from 71s to 29s (2.4× speedup).

evidence.anchor: from 71s to 29s (2.4× speedup)

abstract_sentences.text: In summary, SANA-Video enables low-cost, high-quality video generation.

evidence.anchor: low-cost, high-quality video generation

abstract_sentences.text: Code and model will be publicly released.

evidence.anchor: Code and model will be publicly released

introduction_moves.previous_question: What is the cost of high fidelity and long context?
introduction_moves.current_answer: A 5-second 720p sample can require over 75,000 tokens and 32 minutes on H100; full attention and KV cache impede >10-second generation.

introduction_moves.previous_question: How does the model reduce token cost while retaining local detail?

introduction_moves.previous_question: How can linear attention support long video?

introduction_moves.next_hook: Architecture needs data and training support.

evidence.anchor: small and fixed memory

introduction_moves.previous_question: Do the components form a useful system?

introduction_moves.next_hook: The main sections formalize and evaluate the system.

method_moves.problem_answer: Define the RF velocity-prediction objective and conditional variables.

evidence.anchor: u(x^t | t, c; θ) and target velocity v(x)

method_moves.problem_answer: Use condition embeddings to unify T2I, T2V and I2V; set first-frame noise to zero for I2V.

evidence.anchor: setting the noise of the first frame to zero

method_moves.problem_answer: Factorize a long sequence into block-conditioned diffusion distributions with an autoregressive chain rule.

evidence.anchor: product of block distribution using the chain rule

method_moves.problem_answer: Frame high-resolution and long-sequence generation as a token-count and quadratic-attention bottleneck.

evidence.anchor: O(N^2) complexity of self-attention as a major bottleneck

method_moves.problem_answer: Adapt SANA with Wan-VAE for 480P and DCAE-V for 720P; VAE adaptation converges in 5–10K steps.

evidence.anchor: adaptation of both VAEs is highly efficient, converging within 5-10k training steps

method_moves.problem_answer: Continue-pretrain from SANA-1.6B with zero-initialized temporal layers and coarse-to-fine resolution/length.

evidence.anchor: newly added layers are zero-initialized with skip connection

method_moves.problem_answer: Post-train an autoregressive variant in block training followed by self-forcing.

evidence.anchor: conduct autoregressive block training in two steps

method_moves.problem_answer: Extend SANA with ReLU linear attention, 3D RoPE and spatial-temporal Mix-FFN.

evidence.anchor: integrating Rotary Position Embeddings into its efficient ReLU linear attention blocks

method_moves.problem_answer: Place RoPE after ReLU to preserve positional information and localize attention.

evidence.anchor: applying RoPE after the ReLU activation

method_moves.problem_answer: Remove RoPE from the denominator while retaining it in the numerator so the denominator stays positive.

evidence.anchor: we remove RoPE from either the key or the query in the denominator

method_moves.problem_answer: Add a temporal convolution shortcut to Mix-FFN for local temporal relationships and motion continuity.

evidence.anchor: temporal convolution with a shortcut connection

method_moves.problem_answer: Contrast causal full/local attention cache growth with block linear attention.

evidence.section: §3.3.1 Block Linear Attention with KV Cache
evidence.anchor: computational and memory costs grow linearly

method_moves.problem_answer: Rewrite causal linear attention using cumulative state S_j and cumulative key sum.

evidence.section: §3.3.1 Block Linear Attention with KV Cache
evidence.anchor: only the attention state for the ith token Si is required

method_moves.problem_answer: Make Mix-FFN causal with zero padding and cached previous-block last frame.

evidence.section: §3.3.1 Block Linear Attention with KV Cache
evidence.anchor: append an all-zero token to the end of each block

method_moves.problem_answer: Sample monotonically increasing timesteps by selecting one block with SNR and propagating to later blocks.

evidence.anchor: later blocks have larger timestep than early blocks

method_moves.problem_answer: Use self-forcing rollout to reduce exposure bias when generated blocks replace ground-truth conditions.

evidence.anchor: condition blocks are ground truth during training but are generated content during inference

method_moves.problem_answer: Use DCAE-V with F=32, T=4 and C=32 to reduce 720P latent tokens and align channels with SANA.

evidence.anchor: spatial down-sampling factor of F = 32, a temporal factor of T = 4, and channels C = 32

method_moves.problem_answer: Relate DCAE-V compression to 36-second 720P latency and compare reconstruction with other VAEs.

evidence.anchor: SANA-Video can generate a 720P 5s video within just 36 seconds

final_judgment.single_storyline: 视频 token 数增长、quadratic attention 和长序列 KV cache 共同造成效率瓶颈；SANA-Video 以预训练 SANA-1.6B 为基础，使用 Linear Video DiT、RoPE/temporal Mix-FFN 和累计状态 Block Linear Attention，再用单调 SNR/self-forcing、DCAE-V 与数据筛选从 5秒扩展到 minute-length。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 问题规模、三阶段训练概览、式 (2) 数值稳定修正、式 (3) 固定 cache、Table 1 复杂度、Tables 2/4 主结果、Table 5 组件消融、Table 6 AR 比较、Figure 6 NVFP4 速度和结论回收。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 完整 related work、architecture/optimizer/batch/steps、Algorithm 1、VAE 扰动、定性 T2V/I2V、30秒 long benchmark、过滤与 captioning、world-model 数据均在附录；internal data、阈值、seed、评测分布和失败案例仍未公开。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 的系统边界 → 式 (2)/(3) 的机制不变量 → Table 1 的渐近复杂度 → Table 4 的统一主结果 → Table 5 的成对消融，形成最清楚的效率论证路径。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 速度数字跨分辨率、长度、steps、硬件和基线，16×、>13×、8×与53×未统一；没有 variance/seed/统计检验；一分种主要靠单例图，world-model 只有 potential，NVFP4 质量没有数值检验。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 状态压缩替换全局 attention 时，让状态不变量、复杂度表、统一 latency protocol 和组件消融共享输入长度、分辨率与 steps，并把质量、速度、内存分别报告。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 适用于效率型生成模型、状态缓存和可控推理实验；固定状态无法充分汇总全局依赖，或能力需人类/任务评测时，复杂度不变量不能代替 coverage、失败案例和专门能力证据。
